run_search_query: run a search query through the SearchEngineRetriever client and return deduplicated sorted results
create_search_agent: create a SearchEngineRetriever instance from ParlAI opt config for use in wizard search
make_onboarding_world: make an onboarding world for a ParlAI agent, auto-assigning Wizard or Apprentice role

make_world: make an MTurkMultiAgentDialogWorld for running the Wizard of Internet crowd-sourced dialogue task
